description: This file defines a React functional component called PremiumLoggingSettings, which conditionally renders different UI elements based on the 'premiumUser' prop. It imports React, a Text component from @tremor/react, and a LoggingSettings component. The component either displays a message about limited access for non-premium users or renders a LoggingSettings component with provided props.

methods.name: PremiumLoggingSettings
